name: Aisha
source: Touka's friend, (and attendant) who always took care of her. When she lost track of Touka, she attacked the Dungeon assuming that Touka was captured. She initially is not willing to trust demons, but Touka convinces her to get along with the residents of the Dungeon. She decides to stay in the village with Touka.
